app.title: MC Content Localizer
app.clickSelectMod: Click to select or drop mod jar
app.clickSelectShader: Click to select or drop shader pack
app.clickSelectResource: Click to select or drop resource pack
app.modDesc: Supports multi-select, Forge / Fabric / NeoForge, auto-detect language files and hardcoded text
app.shaderDesc: Supports .zip shader packs (Complementary, BSL, etc.), auto-parses UI text and embedded Chinese
app.resourceDesc: Supports .zip resource packs, auto-parses pack.mcmeta description
app.tipSettings: Or configure AI translation service in Settings first
app.deepScanDesc: If text parsing is insufficient, click to perform deep scan on the mod (scans all text files; compiled .class text not supported yet).
app.deepScanText: Deep scan text in mod (unchecked by default, included in translation/export after checking):
app.termModalDesc: These terms were automatically extracted and used for this translation. Check to **add to user glossary** (global effect for future translations); unchecked for one-time use only:
app.riskDesc: This mod contains deep-scanned embedded text (non-language files, directly in json/config files). Modifying these fields may affect mod behavior.
app.riskCheckedDesc: {count} mods' deep-scanned text included in export. Choose handling:
app.skipDeep: Skip deep scan text, export language files only (recommended)
app.includeDeep: Include deep scan text (may have risk)
app.noTranslations: No translations to export (please translate first or check selection)
app.riskOk: Skip deep scan text, export language files only (recommended)
app.riskWarn: Include deep scan text (may have risk)
app.chooseDir: Select directory (generate {count} translated jars, no overwrite)
app.chooseDirPack: Select export directory (generate mods_zh_cn.zip merged resource pack)
app.chooseDirShader: Select export directory (generate translated shader pack)
app.jarExport: Select directory (will generate translated jar, no overwrite)
app.suggestDesc: These terms appear ≥3 times, recommended to add to user glossary for consistent naming. Check to "Add to Glossary" will take effect in next translation.
app.glossaryModalDesc: Select which prompt segment to edit (editable segments are open, core segments are system-preserved):
app.packSettingsDesc: Single pack settings: resource pack format, merged name, export path, whether to export jar
app.packNameDesc: Generated resource pack name prefix, e.g. "Mods_Zh_CN", resulting in {name}.zip
app.exportJarDesc: Whether to generate an independent translated jar for this mod (preserves original file, writes translated content to zh_cn.json or hardcoded locations).
app.exportPathDesc: Export jar or shader pack to specified directory (generates new file with timestamp if not overwriting).
app.exportJarPathDesc: Export translated jar to specified directory (generates new file if not overwriting).
app.alertEmpty: {empty} entries returned empty (AI timeout). Common causes: free model instability, large batch size, network issues. Try: select fewer entries, reduce batch size, or use a more stable model.
app.alertError429: {error} entries failed due to 429 rate limit (red). Free model limits trigger periodically. Try: reduce selected entries, lower thread count, increase request interval, or upgrade model tier.
app.alertErrorOther: {error} entries failed (red), mostly network or config errors. Check API Key, Base URL, model name, and network connectivity.
app.alertWarn: {warn} entries have placeholder/format validation warnings (orange tags). Verify %s, § codes are intact before export to avoid in-game display issues.
app.alertInfo: No new translations in this batch.

settings.modelPlaceholder: Enter API Key then click "Get Model List"

modelDesc.zhipu: Free model, or pull list to choose other models
modelDesc.other: Click "Get Model List" to pull, or enter manually

settings.requestIntervalDesc: Interval between each request per thread; larger intervals reduce rate-limiting risk (recommended ≥ 4s).
settings.warningThreading: Multi-threaded parallelism sends multiple translation requests to the model simultaneously to speed up, but carries risks and limitations:
settings.warningThreadingList1: Free models (glm-4-flash / 4.7-flash) have account-level rate limits (~15-30 req/min). Multi-threading can trigger rate limits (429), with automatic backoff retry.
settings.warningThreadingList2: Free models recommend 1-2 threads, paid models (glm-4.5, etc.) can use 4-8 threads for significant speedup.
settings.warningThreadingList3: Threads are staggered by "request interval" to reduce rate-limit probability; larger intervals are more stable (recommended ≥ 4s).
settings.warningThreadingList4: Different models translating simultaneously may have inconsistent naming style; use the same model for consistency.
settings.deepScanDesc: Parse embedded text in mods that may be missed by regular scan (config/achievements/manuals/nested jars). Compiled .class text not supported.
settings.deepScanTip: When enabled, regular empty triggers enhanced scan. Can also click "Mod Deep Scan" on the pack card.
settings.userGlossaryDesc: Unify naming, e.g. Diamond → Pickaxe; format: English → Chinese
settings.glossaryDesc: No custom glossary yet, click button below to add
settings.author: Author
